paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Temporal variability of targets included in the literature. We see that there has been a gradual rise towards multi-target datasets.
model_annotation: The chart titled “Targets (conceptualized or operationalized) over time” illustrates the distribution of datasets by the number of targets included across publication years using 100% stacked bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories and is labeled “Year,” showing years in chronological order from 2012 through 2022. The vertical axis is a proportion scale running from 0.0 to 1.0 (linear), with regularly spaced tick labels at approximately 0.2 intervals, and each stacked bar reaches a total height of 1.0. A legend labeled “Targets” maps colors to target-count bins: blue = “0,” orange = “1,” green = “2–4,” red = “5–7,” and purple = “8+.” For 2012, the bar is entirely green at about 1.0 (2–4); for 2013, the bar is entirely blue at about 1.0 (0). In 2014, the bar is split into blue (~0.5) and orange (~0.5); in 2015, it is split into blue (~0.5) and green (~0.5). In 2016, the bar shows blue at roughly ~0.25, orange around ~0.5, and green around ~0.25. In 2017, the bar is mostly blue (~0.5) with orange (~0.18–0.2), green (~0.25), and a thin red segment near the top (~0.05–0.1). In 2018, the bar stacks blue at about ~0.4, orange at ~0.25, green at ~0.2, and red at ~0.15. In 2019, the bar includes blue (~0.2), orange (~0.2), green (~0.2), a larger red segment (~0.35), and a small purple cap (~0.03–0.05). In 2020, the bar shows blue (~0.35–0.4), orange (~0.2–0.25), green (~0.25), red (~0.1), and a small purple segment (~0.03–0.05). In 2021, the bar includes blue (~0.35–0.4), orange (~0.2), green (~0.25), red (~0.15–0.2), and a very small purple segment (~0.01–0.03). In 2022, the stacked bar is rendered in lighter (more transparent) shades of the same palette, with approximate segment heights of blue (~0.33), orange (~0.28–0.30), green (~0.20–0.22), and red (~0.15–0.18), and no clearly visible purple segment; the bars appear ordered by year and are not otherwise specially emphasized with outlines or annotations.
